study type: Secondary analysis of a randomized controlled trial data (prospective cohort)
exposure: Early postpartum weight retention (PPWR at 6-16 weeks)
Gestational age at start of insulin therapy in pregnancy
cohort: The study included 167 women who had prediabetes at 6-16 weeks postpartum after a recent history of gestational diabetes (GDM).
finding: Early postpartum weight retention (PPWR) was a strong independent predictor for late PPWR, while earlier start of insulin therapy during pregnancy and delivery by caesarean section were independent predictors of glucose intolerance at 1-year postpartum.
mod_finding: Delivery by caesarean section was identified as an independent predictor of glucose intolerance at 1-year postpartum.
